beats.say: There's a tiny vibrating crystal inside your watch, keeping perfect time.
A quartz crystal is drawn as a small rectangle between two plates.
Quartz vibrates at a very precise frequency. Watch crystals vibrate thirty two thousand, seven hundred and sixty eight times a second.
Halve that fifteen times, and you get exactly one tick per second.
